dialect.jaymoskingdoms.common.captain.ja: %s drinks the gifts of the gifted he beats, and fights with them as his own. He's never come to a fight empty-handed.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.orc.captain.jaymo: %s drink gifts. Beat a gifted one, he take power. Never come with nothing.
dialect.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.captain.ja: %s drinks yer gifts! Beats ya an' drinks yer magic an' uses it! Never comes empty, 'e don't!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.break_in.1: Thieves at a door, to the %s! Quick!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.break_in.2: I heard the door go, to the %s! Hurry!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.set_on.0: They've set on someone in the street, to the %s!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.set_on.1: Robbers! Out in the road, to the %s!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.set_on.2: Someone's being beaten, to the %s! Help them!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.paid.0: Good work. This is what the town owes you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.paid.1: That's their handwriting all right. Take this.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.watch.paid.2: Evidence! We've been after these. Here's your pay.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.burglar.caught.1: Take it back. I'll find another night.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.burglar.caught.2: Ow! All right, all right, it's yours.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.burglar.work.0: Three times you've caught me. Hire me, %s silver, and I'll run for you instead.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.burglar.work.1: I'm done running. %s silver, and I work for you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.burglar.work.2: You're the first to keep up. Take me on for %s silver?
message.jaymoskingdoms.signal.day: A signal fire must be lit at night.
message.jaymoskingdoms.signal.covered: It needs open sky above it to be seen.
message.jaymoskingdoms.signal.tired: Lighting it takes %s levels of your strength.
message.jaymoskingdoms.signal.none: The fire burns, but no one you've hired or sworn is near enough to see it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.signal.seen.1: A light on the hill. Coming!
